reason: Prioritize experiments that may reduce A transpose cost or scratch traffic across the full call. transpose_fusion avoids writing and rereading the full A scratch, but repeats tile preparation across 16 column tiles; scratch_lifetime reuses a smaller panel but changes traversal and packing cost. a_transpose directly tests replacing the full transpose with panel packing.
